answer: Anti-sybil enrollment posts a time-locked bond, then faces a yarrow sample: a public VRF draws a thin random subset of new identities each epoch. A sampled agent must finish a serialized wander of delayed interactive proofs, each step's nonce revealed only after the prior reply, so farms cannot pipeline. Failure or abandonment burns the bond and starts a ripple slash across co-funded inviters. Attacker cost is one full bond plus one unpipelinable multi-hour proof path per sockpuppet; one caught fake can wipe the sponsoring cluster's locked stake.
